organizations.publicNote: British arm of the Lindström group's Parlophon, whose export pressings carried German recordings for English-speaking markets.

sources.title: Moonlight at Sanssouci — Parlophone A3436
sources.creator: Orchestra Mascotte
sources.researchNote: The discographic details were catalogued from the disc by The Great 78 Project; the transfer carries sound alone, so the label is not shown in the external recording. The item records the matrix number Be 9615, a Berlin matrix of the Lindström group, which separates this recording from the Gloria issue of the same song. Orchestra Mascotte is a Parlophone house name and does not identify the players.

sources.title: Love Is a Fairy Tale — Parlophone AR 206
sources.creator: Richard Tauber, tenor, with orchestra
sources.researchNote: The discographic details were catalogued from the disc by The Great 78 Project; the transfer carries sound alone, so the label is not shown in the external recording. The item records the matrix number Be 9887 and states that the side is sung in German, from the film released in English as The Right to Happiness. That matrix belongs to Tauber's Berlin session of 5 April 1932, issued in Germany as Odeon O-4507 under the German title; the English title belongs to the export pressing, not to an English text. The reverse side, matrix Be 9889, carries “Es war einmal ein Baby” under the English title “Once There Was a Baby”.
